title: Deer in a little scarf
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='24' ry='18' fill='#b5651d'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='34' y='78' width='7' height='16' rx='3' fill='#8a4a12'/>
  <rect x='59' y='78' width='7' height='16' rx='3' fill='#8a4a12'/>
  <!-- neck -->
  <rect x='44' y='40' width='14' height='20' rx='6' fill='#b5651d'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='51' cy='34' rx='14' ry='12' fill='#b5651d'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='28' rx='6' ry='9' fill='#d1843a' transform='rotate(-25 34 28)'/>
  <ellipse cx='68' cy='28' rx='6' ry='9' fill='#d1843a' transform='rotate(25 68 28)'/>
  <!-- antlers -->
  <path d='M42 24 L36 10 M36 10 L28 6 M36 10 L40 4' stroke='#f2c48a' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M60 24 L66 10 M66 10 L74 6 M66 10 L62 4' stroke='#f2c48a' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <!-- snout -->
  <ellipse cx='51' cy='41' rx='9' ry='6' fill='#e8a76a'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='51' cy='39' rx='3.5' ry='2.5' fill='#5a2d0c'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='45' cy='32' r='2.6' fill='#2a1408'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='32' r='2.6' fill='#2a1408'/>
  <circle cx='45.8' cy='31.2' r='0.9' fill='#fff3e0'/>
  <circle cx='57.8' cy='31.2' r='0.9' fill='#fff3e0'/>
  <!-- scarf -->
  <path d='M36 50 Q51 58 66 50 L66 57 Q51 65 36 57 Z' fill='#e63946'/>
  <path d='M62 55 L70 72 L64 73 L58 57 Z' fill='#f7707a'/>
  <path d='M64 73 L70 72 L71 78 L65 78 Z' fill='#e63946'/>
  <!-- scarf stripes -->
  <path d='M40 51 L40 56' stroke='#ffd166' stroke-width='2'/>
  <path d='M50 54 L50 60' stroke='#ffd166' stroke-width='2'/>
  <path d='M60 54 L60 59' stroke='#ffd166' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <ellipse cx='74' cy='65' rx='4' ry='5' fill='#f2e3d0'/>
</svg>
